content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP® Certification in Oak Ridge

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a bachelor's degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high school diploma plus five years. Professionals in Oak Ridge's national laboratories, defense contractors, and engineering firms typically meet these criteria. Verify your specific background against PMI's requirements before enrolling.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual PMP Bootcamp—instructor-led classes designed for working professionals. Attend sessions on your schedule from anywhere, covering the PMBOK® Guide framework, exam domains, and real-world scenarios. All instruction is delivered online; no travel or in-person attendance required.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing bootcamp coursework, apply directly to PMI through their online portal. Document your education and project-management experience, then pay the associated exam fee. PMI will verify your eligibility and issue authorization to sit for the PMP® exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy provides targeted exam-preparation resources, practice tests, and study guidance to strengthen weak areas. Schedule your exam at a Prometric testing center or take it online. Sit for the computer-based PMP® exam and receive your pass/fail result.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP® Credential
steps_items.text: After certification, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) over a three-year renewal cycle by attending training, presenting, or contributing to project-management communities. Renew your credential with PMI before expiration to remain active in your role.
